Item: Map of Streets in Taipei City under Direct Jurisdiction
Subject: Taipei
Description:
The "Map of Taipei City (Directly-Administered
Areas)" published by Ta Yu Publishing House, with a scale of approximately 1:30,000, was published in 1985. It covers most of Taipei City and is categorized as both a city street map and an administrative district map. Contents include district boundaries (the old 16 districts before 1990), streets, and important landmarks. There is no topographical depiction, no latitude or longitude coordinates, and the map is oriented north. The reverse side features street maps of Banqiao, Sanchong, Zhongyonghe, Xindian, and Xinzhuang.
